card_note: Official 14-bout October 24 UFC 333 card (Abu Dhabi). American prices frozen from the ufc.com event page at retrieval; Yan-Dvalishvili had no ufc.com price, so its FanDuel price from BestFightOdds is used. Asaf Chopurov and both Iasmin Lucindo / Nicolle Caliari are absent from prediction_data.csv, so those bouts are excluded. Vagaev-Malkoun and Oki-Santos are listed with Malkoun/Santos as fighter1 because their latest historical division matches the official bout division (middleweight, featherweight), while Vagaev (welterweight) and Oki (lightweight) do not. Model and inputs are unchanged from UFC 332 (prediction_data.csv built 2026-08-14). Positive-EV picks are Pending.
